The Applied AI & GenAI ground truth in Capital Markets & Wealth Management: Wealth and capital-markets clients buy judgment and pay for experience: advisors need research and portfolio context in minutes, operations need settlement and reconciliation without firefights, and compliance needs evidence without expeditions.

Reconciliation and breaks manual is the concrete face of a general problem: the work is shaped for a world of manual checks and batch updates, while volume and scrutiny both grew. We start with the queue, the wait and the number they produce — not with a platform license.
where the friction concentrates, Capital Markets & Wealth Management edition:

items: Custody, clearing and fund reconciliation produce breaks cleared by spreadsheet; month-end compresses.
Positions, performance and fees reconcile from extracts; client questions wait on report runs.
Advisors assemble portfolio context from terminals, PDFs and CRM; response quality depends on prep time.
Suitability checks and disclosure packs assembled manually per trade; audit trails thin.

blocks.x: In Capital Markets & Wealth Management, the pattern is advisor copilot — portfolio context, research and market moves summarized with citations pre-meeting. Prep time down 40-60% sits on top as the measured result, tracked from the signed baseline onward. Around it, the work is model and retrieval engineering with evaluation wired in from the first sprint — grounded answers, cited sources, and a cost line somebody actually owns.

By the time the regulator asks, the evidence already exists — that is the point of designing controls first.
